payload.author: experimental_development
payload.hypothesis: A compact CIFAR-style ResNet with progressive channel expansion (64→128→256), residual connections, and dataset-specific normalization will effectively capture both local nuclear morphology and tissue-level texture in 28x28 histopathology patches. With ~3.2M parameters it has sufficient capacity for 90k samples while fitting in CPU memory. The residual architecture enables deeper feature hierarchies without vanishing gradients, and the global average pooling + dropout head provides regularization against overfitting on small patches. Class-weighted CE and label smoothing address the mild imbalance and label ambiguity risks.
